name: Tiatr Research Scholarship Program
benefit:
> ***Scholarship Amount***

The amount of each scholarship will be decided by Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG) from time to time.
> ***Publication of Research Work***

The research work of the students will be printed by Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG) in book form after approval by the Recommendation Board.
> ***Copies of Published Work***

Each student concerned will receive 100 copies of their printed res
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a bonafide student who does research work or a project related to Tiatr. - The applicant must conduct research work in English and Konkani (Roman script only). - The applicant should have secured at least 50% marks in the last examination. - The applicant must submit a report of the research carried out, duly signed either by the guide or the head of the institution.
